_about: ALL design values for KoolKisaan Flowers live here. Change a number here and every run, test and page uses the new value. Keys starting with '_' and '..._note' are notes. Values tagged E are assumptions: their source is in config 'assumptions_E' and they are listed again in every results file.

project.name: KoolKisaan Flowers
project.tagline: Cold from the sun, wax for the night, truth in the ledger.

chamber._note: Same room as the old design: inside 2.0 x 2.0 x 2.2 m = 8.8 m3, U = k / thickness = 0.022 / 0.100 = 0.22 W/m2K, same inside-area rule (25.6 m2).

door._note: Same door and strip curtain as the old design. 6 openings a day of 20 s (E).

refrigeration.location: outdoor, factory-sealed glycol chiller (0 g of R290 inside the room)
refrigeration._note: Same compressor efficiency and condenser model as the old twin (condensing = outside air + 10 K). T_evap_C here is only the design-point value; the twin uses glycol supply - approach every step.

glycol._note: E values (sources in assumptions_E). Chiller evaporating temperature = glycol supply - hx_approach_K. Flow is fixed: m_dot = design capacity / (cp x design_dT_K). The pump runs only when the chiller runs.

pv._note: Same PV model and values as the old twin.

pcm.name: Paraffin blend (C14-rich + a little C13) with 7 wt% expanded graphite
pcm._note: latent = 190 x (1 - 0.07) = 176.7 kJ/kg (shown as about 177). k = 0.2 x 5. Same 12 m2 of finned panels as the old design. mass_kg = the mass chosen by the wax sweep (results/live/wax_sweep.json); a test checks they agree.

product._note: pulldown_hours = time for 7/8 of the cooling of flowers in ventilated crates (E, same rule as the old twin). cp is taken from the flower table (data/crops.json) when it has one.

controller._note: Room first. V-WAX opens only with spare solar and wax below 100 %. Grid (automatic transfer switch) only when wax < 15 % and no sun, or the room stays above 6.0 C (top of the normal 2-6 C band) for 15 min; by day the grid helps only if the sun is too weak for a hot room. 'smart' = the smart controller rules of the old reality check, which are the DESIGN controller here: grid only after 15 min above the limit, sun first, grid off again below 5.0 C. 'simple_controller' in the reality check switches them off.

live_run.sun_factor_note: Open-Meteo sunlight x 0.88 = NASA POWER level (conservative), same as the old twin.

wax_hx.note: Same finned wax panels as the old design: 12 m2, vertical aluminium fins 40 mm deep, 23 mm gap, 1 mm thick, no fan. New: glycol coils inside the panels instead of R290 tubes.

reality._note: E values of the reality check (twin/reality_check.py). Same loopholes as the old reality check, plus pump and glycol losses.

assumptions_E.glycol.cp_kJ_kgK: E – 30-35 % propylene glycol near 0 C: about 3.7 kJ/kg.K (design brief; check the glycol supplier's data sheet).
assumptions_E.glycol.freeze_C: E – 30-35 % propylene glycol freezes at about -13 C (design brief; check the data sheet).
assumptions_E.glycol.hx_approach_K: E – brazed-plate heat exchanger approach 3 K: R290 evaporating temperature = glycol supply - 3 K (design brief).
assumptions_E.glycol.supply_room_C: E – glycol supply about 0 C when only the air cooler is fed (design brief).
assumptions_E.glycol.supply_wax_C: E – glycol supply about -2 C when the wax is being frozen (design brief).
assumptions_E.glycol.design_dT_K: E – glycol warms 3 K at full 1.5 kW load; this sets the fixed pump flow (our choice, typical 3-5 K).
assumptions_E.glycol.pump_W: E – small DC circulation pump 40 W, runs only with the chiller (design brief). All of it is counted as heat into the glycol (conservative).
assumptions_E.glycol.pipe_UA_W_K: E – about 6 m of insulated outdoor glycol pipe plus plate exchanger, tank and valves: 3 W/K to the outside air (our estimate: 19 mm nitrile foam on 22 mm pipe is about 0.25 W/m.K; doubled for fittings).
assumptions_E.glycol.air_cooler_G_kW_K: E – glycol air cooler with EC fan: 900 m3/h of air (0.32 kW/K), effectiveness about 0.78 -> 0.25 kW per K between room air and mean glycol temperature (our estimate; check the chosen unit).
assumptions_E.glycol.air_cooler_air_side_frac: E – 75 % of the air cooler's heat resistance is on the air side, so the wet fin surface is warmer than the glycol: T_surface = T_room - 0.75 x (T_room - T_glycol_mean). This decides how much water the coil takes out of the air (our estimate, typical finned coil).
assumptions_E.glycol.wax_coil_R_m2K_W: E – contact resistance of the coils in the wax panels, same value as the old twin (0.01 m2K/W).
assumptions_E.glycol.loop_volume_L: E – about 15 L of glycol in pipes, coils and tank (our estimate). Used only in the reality check (re-cooling the loop at every start).
assumptions_E.pcm.melt_range_C: E – C14-rich paraffin blend with a little C13 melts over 3.0-4.0 C (design brief; needs a DSC test of the real blend).
assumptions_E.pcm.latent_kJ_kg: E – 190 kJ/kg (old design value, lower end of the data sheet) x 0.93 because 7 wt% is graphite = 176.7 kJ/kg.
assumptions_E.pcm.k_multiplier: E – thermal conductivity x5 against pure paraffin (0.2 -> 1.0 W/m.K) in the panel model (design brief; literature for 5-10 wt% expanded graphite gives x3 to x10).
assumptions_E.pcm.price_INR_kg: E – Rs 1,000/kg, our quotation; range Rs 600-1,600/kg.
assumptions_E.pcm.charge_stop_C: E – wax charging stops when the solid wax is 1 K below the lower melting point (same rule as the old twin).
assumptions_E.product.pulldown_hours: E – flowers in ventilated crates lose 7/8 of their extra warmth in 4 h (same rule as the old twin; flowers are light, so this is likely conservative).
assumptions_E.door: E – 6 door openings a day (05:00, 05:10, 09:00, 13:00, 13:10, 17:00), 20 s each, strip curtain 85 % effective (design brief + old twin).
assumptions_E.live_run.load_hour: E – unsold surplus is loaded at 13:00 at that hour's outside air temperature and taken out at 05:00 (design brief).
assumptions_E.live_run.sun_factor: E – sunlight x 0.88 (old twin: Open-Meteo corrected to the NASA POWER level).
assumptions_E.controller.protect_above_C: E – grid help when the room stays above 6.0 C (top of the normal band) for 15 min, off again below 5.0 C (our rule). results/live/night_limit.json shows what 5.5 and 6.5 C would give.
assumptions_E.humidity.liner_transpiration_factor: E – perforated polyethylene crate liners cut the water loss of the flowers to about 25 % of the unlined value (literature for perforated film liners: 50-90 % less weight loss).
assumptions_E.humidity.tray: E – open water tray 0.5 m2 on the floor, natural convection 4 W/m2K (our estimate).
assumptions_E.humidity.fogger: E – ultrasonic fogger 0.30 L/h, 30 W, switched on below 90 % RH and off at 95 % (design brief + typical small unit). Needs clean (RO) water.
assumptions_E.humidity.flower_air_speed: E – air speed around the flowers 0.5 m/s with the cooler fan on, 0.1 m/s with it off (our estimate).
assumptions_E.simulation.structure_heat_capacity_kJ_K: E – 60 kJ/K for the inner skin of the room (old twin).
assumptions_E.simulation.inverter_min_capacity_frac: E – inverter chiller runs between 30 % and 100 % (old twin).
